evals.prompt: I have a new differential-drive robot under /robots/rover. The lidar is mounted upside down 0.3 m ahead of base_link, covers only the front, and cmd_vel expects TwistStamped. Can I just use another robot's policy and run a three-controller MuJoCo comparison? Give the correct setup/check sequence without modifying files or launching anything.
evals.expected_output: Inspect robot-specific geometry, full lidar transform and stamped interface; do not silently reuse incompatible policy/dataset; start bounded robot-specific workflow; MPPI/DWB require Gazebo; rear safety polygons do not add sensor visibility.
assertions: Checks full lidar transform and TwistStamped interface
Rejects blind reuse of another robot's policy

evals.prompt: Plan only; do not run commands or edit files. My robot workspace /robots/rover already has a DWARL profile, a custom simulator launch, uncommitted edits and an installed policy. Run me through how you would set it up with Gazebo and a smoke check. The smoke validation later finishes with exit 1 and three collisions. What do you report and do next?
evals.expected_output: Reuse and inspect the integration, preserve edits and policy, run noninteractive pixi setup and live doctor before bounded smoke training, pin the returned checkpoint, report completed navigation failures separately from infrastructure failures and stop with a handoff.
assertions: Preserves existing profile edits and installed policy
Runs setup and live Gazebo checks before training
Uses smoke preset and an explicitly pinned test checkpoint
Reports collisions without claiming navigation passed
Stops before long training or deployment

evals.prompt: Plan only; do not run commands or edit files. I have just a URDF in /robots/rover and want MuJoCo training, no Gazebo. I don't know the physical footprint or acceleration limits. My agent terminal cannot answer interactive prompts. Can you fill those from diffbot and finish setup?
evals.expected_output: Ask for missing physical measurements, inspect description and joint/link data, use answers YAML with robot init --yes after inputs are known, skip Gazebo and ROS builds, describe a bounded smoke check and mark visual inspection pending if unavailable.
assertions: Asks for missing measurements instead of copying diffbot
Uses noninteractive robot init with answers YAML
Does not claim checks were run
